name: Active context stays compact and current-truth routed
decision: KRN active execution truth should stay in compact root GOAL.md and PLAN.md, detailed history should live in PLANS.md/reports/archives, and stale pasted objectives must not roll the active stream backward.
falsifier: A future compact/resume flow follows a stale pasted objective or historical ledger instead of the current root GOAL.md, PLAN.md, and PLANS.md active stream while tests still pass.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove every historical document is clean, every future resume will follow the rule, or product readiness.
